objects.name: account
objects.description: A member's account, a structure's contribution basket, a paybill, a bank, or the suspense account an unmatched statement row lands in until somebody claims it.

objects.name: entry
objects.description: One movement of money in the contribution ledger: a contribution posted, a handout issued, an import matched, a correction reversing any of them.

objects.name: budget
objects.description: What a basket or an account is expected to collect or spend over one period, read against what was actually posted.
